Simple heading followed by paragraph produces Heading and Paragraph nodes

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"include_document_structure\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>A paragraph of text.</p>", options)
    println(result.content)
    println(result.document?.nodes)
}
```
